hero.title: Aerospace Engineering (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Bachelor's in Aerospace Engineering is designed to cover the design, development, testing and maintenance of aircraft, spacecraft, propulsion systems and related technologies. Students interested in aerodynamics, aircraft structures, flight control, and space systems can be drawn to the field. **Aerospace Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** requires careful research into available degree options and related engineering pathways. Students searching for **Aerospace Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** should first understand which related qualifications are actually available.

overview: Important for those who are going to study in Mauritius: There is no specific Bachelor’s in Aerospace Engineering on the official list of undergraduate programs of the University of Mauritius for 2026-2027. Related degrees include Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, and Electrical and Electronic Engineering. These can give you relevant engineering foundations, but are not the same as an aerospace engineering degree. Students planning to **Study Aerospace Engineering in Mauritius** should understand this distinction before choosing a course.

faq.question: Can I do a Bachelor’s in Aerospace Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius’s published undergraduate list for 2026-2027 does not include a dedicated Aerospace Engineering degree. It also gives related options like Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering.

faq.question: Which university should I consider for aerospace studies in Mauritius?
faq.answer: You can check the University of Mauritius for relevant engineering degrees. Students should consult the course structure and see if it supports their intentions for an aerospace specialization later on.

faq.question: Indian students can apply: Who can apply?
faq.answer: Generally students need to have Class 12 or equivalent recognized qualification along with mathematics and relevant science subjects. Entry requirements vary depending on the program and university you choose.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Aerospace Engineering in Mauritius in Indian Rupees?
faq.answer: No aerospace-specific tuition fee is confirmed from the program listings examined. As a rough estimate, excluding tuition and one-time expenses, living expenses can be in the range of ₹4.67-₹8.89 lakh annually. Before you finalize your budget, check the official fees for the specific degree.

faq.question: What kind of jobs can I get with a degree in aerospace-related engineering?
faq.answer: Depending on your degree and any additional training you have, you might think about roles in aerospace design, aerodynamics, aircraft structures, avionics, propulsion, CAD, systems engineering or research. Some aviation related jobs require separate professional licences or special qualifications.
